rules.name: Run and Gun
rules.description: A Section of models with the Run and Gun MAR may perform their Ranged Attack at any point during the movement segment of their Activation. This does not allow the Section to move and perform a Ranged Attack they would otherwise be unable to perform (for example a Run Move Action or firing a Move or Fire weapon).

rules.name: Lucky
rules.description:
A model with the Lucky MAR has a number of Luck
Tokens equal to the value of the MAR.

Each Luck Token may be spent at ANY point to allow the
model with Lucky to re-roll ON E Dice. Dice that may be
re-rolled include any Attack Dice (AD), Ironclad Attack
Dice (IAD), Melee Attack Dice (MAD) and Command
Test Dice. 
A Dice CANNOT be re-rolled more than once,
and the second result MUST be accepted.
The number of Luck Tokens that the model has
available for the duration of the game is determined
IMMEDIATELY BEFORE rolling for initiative for the
first Turn. 
A model CANNOT regain spent Luck Tokens
during a game.

rules.name: Fight Harder or Say Hello to Louise!
rules.description:
Fight Harder or Say Hello to Louise!
Command Point Cost: 1
Passes Required: 1	
Issued in: Issued after a Section fails a Morale Test.
Order: A Section may re-roll the test. If passed remove all Shaken Markers from the Section, if failed the Section gains an additional Shaken Marker.

rules.name: Scramble!
rules.description:
Command Point Cost: 3
Passes Required: 2
Issued in: Issued when a FSA Infantry Section comes under enemy fire.
Order: An Infantry Section that is ordered to Scramble! May make an immediate D3+3” Move after the Enemy declared their attack, and before any dice are rolled. Ranges for the attack use the positions of the models after they Scramble! Models in a Section that has been Ordered to Scramble! must maintain coherency.

rules.name: Daunting
rules.description:
When a Section is successfully charged by a Section with the Daunting MAR it must take a Morale Check Command Test, Requiring TWO successes, IMMEDIATLY after all charging models have completed their Movement.

If the Morale Command Test is failed the Section gains a Shaken Marker.
If the Morale Check Command Test is passed there is no effect.

If the charged Section already has a Shaken Marker it only needs to take ON E Morale Check Command Test however it requires an ADDITION AL success to pass.

sharedRules.name: Adaptable
sharedRules.description: James Powell is a long surviving veteran of the Armoured Infantry, eschewing promotion to stay with the unit he loves so much, Powell has seen more action than most.  Any Section of Armoured Infantry James Powell is attached to gains the Hit and Run MAR (which lasts as long as Powell survives).
